base: Use case: stylized-concept. Attached image is an ART STYLE reference ONLY: its angular editorial caricature shapes, warm ivory / muted teal / burgundy / navy palette, and subtle printed texture. Do NOT copy any of its characters or poses. Translate that graphic language into a genuinely THREE-DIMENSIONAL cartoon political office game world. Create a VERTICAL portrait concept of one in-game view, no collage, no split panels, no character lineup. CRITICAL CAMERA: FIRST PERSON SEATED BEHIND THE PLAYER'S WORK DESK, looking across the visible desktop into the room, as if player occupies the office. Desk fills bottom 30 percent, a fully volumetric fictional political office fills upper 70 percent. Clear depth, modelled solid furniture and props with actual thickness and cast shadows, chairs on floor, window recesses, corners and a three-dimensional visiting character. NOT a flat painted background with a pasted 2D character. The player hands need not be visible. Original room: modest but characterful campaign administrator workplace, painted muted blue-green walls, a tall side window showing fictional civic architecture, one offset entrance to a hallway, bulletin board with abstract colored notes, asymmetrical bookcase and a small plant. Desk: plain wood with deep navy desk pad, a compact cream push-button telephone, red ceramic mug, loose papers with colored tabs, pen holder. No parchment dossier centerpiece, no three identical door navigation, no copy of any old game room. One ORIGINAL visitor standing on the OTHER side of desk, visible about waist-up behind it: woman about 40 with straight dark hair in a low ponytail, prominent straight brows, a short wide angular face, plum waistcoat over a rolled-sleeve ivory shirt, holding a slim document case at her side, inquisitive slightly skeptical expression. NOT curly-haired glasses woman, NOT old silver-haired man, NOT broad-jawed male rival, NOT silver-haired mentor, NOT red-haired young man. Modelled stylized caricature visitor, dark angular painted shadow shapes, expressive eyebrows, adult political comedy. Everyday office rather than royal palace, restrained richness. Room and character have a SINGLE coherent rendering style. No existing flags, logos, text, floating interface or dialogue panels, watermarks. This is a concept of a playable 3D scene, not a photograph, not clay or plasticine. Make modelled 3D depth unmistakable while keeping graphic stylization.

variants.title: Стол 1 — 3D с рисованными материалами
variants.style: PRIMARY STYLE: stylized real-time 3D with artist-painted materials. Chunky solid forms with gently beveled edges, strong angular facial design, subdued physically plausible diffuse shading and cast shadows, tactile dry-brush color texture painted ON 3D surfaces, not a paper overlay. Broad warm side daylight and soft cool room shadows. Muted mature colors and satin-matte surfaces. More geometric and editorial than cute Pixar. Modelled character with coherent volumetric nose, cheeks, ears, clothes and hands, subtle rim light. Cozy slightly satirical handmade painted videogame world, not miniature toy.

variants.title: Стол 2 — Гранёный 3D
variants.style: PRIMARY STYLE: sophisticated angular LOW-POLY real-time 3D scene. Deliberate visible planar geometry in the character's face, furniture, window surrounds and plant. Flat painted color materials with subtle warm pigment variation, crisp geometric sunlight across desk and floor, expressive exaggerated character proportions based on editorial caricature. Simple slightly oversized head, long elegant hands, sharp eyebrows. No glossy shading and no detailed realistic skin. Distinct objects with thickness, occlusion and clear perspective; coherent actual low-poly game screenshot aesthetic. Navy, dusty teal, burgundy, ochre and warm offwhite.

variants.title: Стол 3 — Объёмная карикатура с контуром
variants.style: PRIMARY STYLE: true 3D CEL-SHADED political cartoon game. Solid modelled characters and furniture with selective thin dark ink outlines, two or three clearly separated lighting tones, elegant angular ink shadow shapes, subtle screen-print roughness restricted to albedo. Clear physical perspective and solid forms, ambient contact shadows preserve depth, not a flat 2D drawing. Editorial caricature facial proportions closely fit reference's angular expressive style while this is a completely new character. Dark navy contour, warm ivory highlights, muted teal and wine red color blocks. Sharp theatrical daylight from side window. More mature witty comic game than glossy animation.
